authority: Explicit user directive PersonaSLM — REAL-SPEAKER EXPERIMENTAL ACCELERATION, sections 7, 8, 13 and 14, plus continuing Autonomous Research Charter

automatic_scorer.copying: for each latent S/F/H/query source in every condition: unique generated-trigram precision present in the union of source-unit trigram sets, plus maximum per-unit longest-common-substring length divided by normalized generated length; empty/short generated text scores 0; empty source scores 0
automatic_scorer.factorial_effects: with x_j=2*factor_j-1, every nonempty subset A is 2*mean(y*product(x_j)); a main effect is mean(factor=1)-mean(factor=0), and interactions use the same Hadamard product coding
automatic_scorer.inference: descriptive speaker-paired estimates only; no confirmatory p-values
automatic_scorer.missingness: native/API failure has structural validity 0 and all text-derived outcomes missing; a successful empty response has structural validity 0, reference-F1/copy/length 0, and Japanese/style missing; other unassessable text outcomes are missing
automatic_scorer.normalization: Unicode NFKC, casefold, remove all whitespace, retain punctuation
automatic_scorer.reference_overlap: set trigram F1; normalized generated strings shorter than three characters score 0; the materializer guarantees normalized references of at least eight characters
automatic_scorer.response_unit: boundary-certified nonempty first unit except TRUNCATED and containing none of the four frozen exposed prompt-section labels; otherwise structurally invalid

style_proxy.distance: equal-weight mean absolute difference; lower is closer
style_proxy.mean_length_definition: characters divided by 50 in source and generated vectors
style_proxy.scope: secondary mixed stylometric proxy; one short response is unstable

blocks.B1: exactly four speakers x eight conditions = 32 requests
blocks.B2: exactly four speakers x eight conditions = 32 requests
blocks.stopping: both blocks execute in one allocation; stop only for registered safety, integrity, technical, cumulative-budget, inference-time, or wall-time failure; never stop or continue based on outcomes
